question: What must Essays enable, how may Whisper contribute, and how can its governing product model remain inspectable?
answer: Develop Governed Essay must enable attributable intent, inspectable composition planning, versioned drafting, addressable review, bounded validation, visible residue, and clean export; Inspect Essays Product Model must expose a read-only, provenance-preserving view of definitions, products, projects, and ontologies; Whisper remains a source-owned candidate partial realization whose adoption and conformance remain separate.
claim_ceiling: Candidate Product Capability and Whisper realization boundary only; no capability adoption, complete realization, conformance, runtime, frontend, upstream reuse, or product-value claim.
